The Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club, a county Democratic club whose stated purpose includes supporting Israel as a democratic, inclusive, and secure Jewish state, recorded a general-phase endorsement of Lamnin; a second endorsement entry appears in campaign-claim form. The research identifies her as the strongest candidate in this race.
